item.title: ‘I’m retired bro’: Gukesh’s cheeky reply to troll gets unexpected twist
item.summary: World champion D Gukesh shared a funny exchange with an online troll who initially told him to retire. After Gukesh jokingly replied, “Sorry I’m retired bro” when asked for a chess match, the user revealed it was a dare from friends. Gukesh posted the exchange with “Haters are fun bro” amid scrutiny over his recent form.
